the genetic basis of seed oil traits in J. curcas was revealed, and the QTL mapping and eQTL mapping were applied to identify candidate genes for molecular breeding of jatropha.

The main takeaway from our work is that
QTL mapping can be used to identify genes that are relevant to oil traits in jetropha.
QTLs and expression QTLs of the major oil genes are identified and mapped in jatropha for the first time.
